result: Sampled visual evidence is consistent with the recorded full score.
method: Native image inspection of FFmpeg-extracted keyframes plus numerical review of all 401 measured state samples. This is not a frame-by-frame manual review of the video.

visual_findings.setup: Separate upright red and blue four-stud bricks are visible, with neutral metric guides and both arms in the overview.
visual_findings.seating: At 11.35 s the red and blue rectangular faces meet without a visible open gap; no exposed blue studs suggest a partial or offset join.
visual_findings.unsupported_lift: At 14.55 and 15.8 s the fingers visibly grip the red piece only, the blue piece hangs below it, and the pair is visibly clear of the tabletop. The policy overview also shows the other arm away.
visual_findings.released_finish: At 19 and 20 s the fingers are open and withdrawing; the joined pair remains upright on the tabletop with no visible displacement.
visual_findings.anonymity: No team name, person name, username, institution, file path or distinctive team branding appears in the inspected frames. Composite overlays contain only camera-role labels and simulation time.

limitations: Exact submillimetre seating and millimetre hand-clearance values come from measured telemetry, not visual pixel estimates.
The close-up can hide the far fingertip; the additional policy views and recorded envelopes support the no-lower-support check.
This simulated demonstration does not establish the fit or strength of physical printed bricks.
source_hash_scope: Hashes refer to original local run files; curated numeric traces are separately hashed in VALIDATION.json.
